description: This file defines the LDAPTestConnectionAPI class which provides an API endpoint for testing LDAP connections within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for creating LDAP connection tests, validating input parameters, and normalizing test results. It interacts with LDAP services to perform authentication tests and fetch user entries, and provides detailed status reports about the LDAP connection and user lookup capabilities.
